test.title: A sports event you watched or took part in

document.cue: Describe a sports event you watched or took part in.

text: I'd like to describe a kokpar match I watched two years ago at a Nauryz festival just outside my grandparents' village in the Almaty region. I went with my cousins and my grandfather, who had been a rider himself when he was young.

For anyone who hasn't seen it, kokpar is a traditional horseback game where two teams of riders fight to carry a goat carcass across the field and throw it into the other team's goal. It sounds strange, but it's incredibly fast and physical, and it takes enormous skill to stay on the horse while everyone is pushing.

The match took place on an open field, and there were no proper seats — people just stood along a rope or watched from the roofs of their cars. At one point a group of riders came charging towards our side, and the whole crowd jumped back at once, laughing and screaming at the same time.

As for how I felt, it was a real mixture of excitement and nerves. I couldn't take my eyes off the horses, and I was honestly a bit scared for the riders. But what I enjoyed most was watching my grandfather, who shouted advice as if he were still on the field.
It made me realise that some traditions aren't just museum pieces — they're still very much alive.
